notes: s001 מַה and s002 שֶׁ each take a word of their own ('That', 'which'), which rule 2 prefers where both correspondences are independently defensible; ECC.3.22 writes a single 'what' for the same pair and is fused there instead.
t021 'again' is added: בָּקַשׁ is the seeking and 'seeketh' has already written it, so no morpheme licenses the adverb (rules 30 and 44). The competing reading folding it into the verb is recorded.
s008 לִ takes 'is to', the construction-supplied copula joining the prepositional predicate and heading on the written preposition (rule 49).
